# a11y-agent-kit

> The Bring Your Own Agent (BYOA) MVP for local accessibility auditing is available on npm as `a11y-agent-kit@0.1.1`. Your coding agent explores rendered browser states with Playwright and axe, saves evidence and checkpoints, and produces HTML reports that label findings awaiting review. The audit workflow collects evidence. The kit has no model service, account, or report upload.

## Install and start

- Use Node.js 22.12+ and npm. Install the matching Chromium with `npx -y playwright@1.64.1 install chromium`.
- Run `npx -y a11y-agent-kit@0.1.1` with the documented subcommand and arguments. See the [first audit command](README.md#run-your-first-audit-from-npm) and [agent prompt](README.md#copy-this-to-your-agent).
- For a global installation, run `npm install -g a11y-agent-kit@0.1.1` and use `a11y-agent-kit` with the same subcommands. For a local stdio MCP host, configure `npx -y a11y-agent-kit@0.1.1 serve`. See [MCP configuration](examples/byoa-audit.md#mcp-connection).

## Skills

- [a11y-audit](skills/a11y-audit/SKILL.md) covers evidence collection, checkpoints, submission, separate review, and HTML delivery. Read the [current copy](https://github.com/szboynono/a11y-agent-kit/blob/main/skills/a11y-audit/SKILL.md). The copy inside the npm 0.1.1 package still describes the earlier source-tree setup, so use the npm commands above for setup.
- [a11y-fix-loop](skills/a11y-fix-loop/SKILL.md) covers the historical, limited analyze/edit/verify/check workflow for button-name, label, and aria-valid-attr.

## Use and output

1. Use the running application's HTTP(S) URL and canonical absolute project root in `evidence/audit-manifest.json`. New audits support WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 at level A or AA. The default is 2.2 AA.
2. Start one persistent JSONL process with `npx -y a11y-agent-kit@0.1.1 audit-agent evidence/audit-manifest.json`. Run snapshot and axe, adopt bound candidates, and explore relevant states. Read original records and view PNGs before making visual claims. Save checkpoints, then explicitly submit the last acknowledged digest. Use fixed batch collection if the host cannot keep a process open.
3. Run `npx -y a11y-agent-kit@0.1.1 audit-report REPORT.json --out evidence/a11y-report.html` with the returned checkpoint, proposal, or reviewed report JSON. Use `--screenshots` only with permission to embed page pixels.
4. Return the HTML and original artifact paths, counts by status, unresolved observations, and untested scope. Submissions stay `needs_review` pending separate review. Use `audit-check` to check integrity and source freshness.

WCAG conformance and real screen-reader speech remain unassessed. Evidence uses absolute, source-bound paths. Keep the original project and evidence tree. The browser and the host agent may use the network. The host controls what captured text, URLs, and pixels reach its model.
